description: Resume enables ChatGPT to analyze, improve, and generate professional, ATS-friendly resumes. Upload a PDF or DOCX resume to identify key gaps, strengthen experience bullets, and refine impact with targeted suggestions. Resume then turns those improvements into a clean, structured, and downloadable PDF resume optimized for readability and applicant tracking systems — all within the ChatGPT conversation, without starting from scratch.
